    // The component-wise product of two system vectors. This one function is
    // both the diagonal preconditioner and the projection onto the free degrees
    // of freedom, because both are diagonal operators.
    SystemProduct(a: Array<Number>, b: Array<Number>): Array<Number>
        => a.Zip(b, (x, y) => x * y);
